game_title: Phone Book Rescue – Yeti Ridge Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge, a ridge known for yetis: the ice axe ranger must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phone Book Rescue: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change.
theme: Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge: a ridge known for yetis
core_gameplay_loop: In Yeti Ridge, repeat each round: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the contacts value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the ice ladder using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The ice ladder reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the ice ladder is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Phone Book Rescue
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phone Book Rescue' (Week 8 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Yeti Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how contacts changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Yeti Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ice ladder reached with actions_used <= 10.
